_about: Reactions used by fixed equilibrium problems: one record per reaction, each value with its source. GROUND OF TRUTH (instructor, 13 Oct 2026): OpenStax Chemistry 2e first; NIST only where the text has no value. The shell never reads this file; the archetype does.

source.Kc: instructor, 10 Oct 2026: derived from NIST ΔG values; the course's rule-of-thumb value. Under the 13 Oct rule (OpenStax first), check Chapter 13 for a stated Kc at this temperature before any new problem uses it.
source.dH_sign: exothermic forward: dH_kJ_mol = −91.8 (SCENARIO_CLAUDE's kit, approved 14 Oct 2026)
source.dH_kJ_mol: NIST ΔHf° of NH3(g), −45.9 kJ/mol, times 2 (instructor, 13 Oct 2026) (approved with the ch13_eq kit, 14 Oct). OpenStax-first rule: the text's value, if Chapter 13 states one, replaces this on the instructor's word.

haber_ammonia.Kc_at_other_T: van 't Hoff from Kc = 0.060 at 773.15 K with ΔH° held constant (rule of thumb); 450 °C 0.161, 550 °C 0.0252, 600 °C 0.0117
